title: Verify DODAGID == AddrForKey(root_pubkey)
close_reason: Added verify_dodagid_binding function to Rust (lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs) matching Python implementation. Verifies DODAGID == AddrForKey(root_pubkey) with constant-time comparison. Added 4 tests for valid binding, mismatch detection, wrong prefix, and all-zeros cases. Both Python and Rust implementations now have equivalent DODAGID binding verification functions.
